Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations

Interface RelationFactory<M extends Model>

Type Parameters:
M - the model class the relation starts from
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface RelationFactory<M extends Model>
Builds one relation of a model; usually a method reference to the model's relation method, such as Post::comments.

  • Method Details

    • create

      Relation<?,?> create(M model)
      Builds the relation for a model.
      Parameters:
      model - the parent model, never null
      Returns:
      the relation, never null
      Implementation Requirements:
      An implementation returns a new, unconstrained relation on every call and never null. It runs once per lazy load, eager load and existence query, from any thread, so it must not keep state between calls.
